title: The Recession's Toll
description: A severe economic slump hits. Your VP of Finance presents a stark choice: Lay off 30% of your workforce to preserve profitability and safeguard investor confidence, OR absorb the losses yourself, protecting your employees but risking a major cash-flow drain.

choices.label: Protect All Employees
choices.description: Absorb the payroll costs. Earn deep workforce trust but lose a massive chunk of liquid capital.

consequences.biographyEntry: “The Sacrifice: In the depth of a harsh economic recession, chose to protect employee livelihood at massive personal expense.”

choices.logMessage: 🛡️ THE SACRIFICE: You chose to protect your workforce, absorbing $150,000 in costs. Your employees vow complete loyalty.

choices.label: Execute Layoffs
choices.description: Terminate 30% of your staff immediately. Protect corporate margins and secure investor satisfaction, but face public backlash.

consequences.biographyEntry: “The Layoffs: Handled the recession with cold financial efficiency, executing widespread layoffs to protect corporate margins.”

choices.logMessage: 📉 THE LAYOFFS: You terminated 30% of your staff, saving $100,000 but drawing fierce public criticism.

title: The Titan's Exit
description: A massive global conglomerate offers to acquire 100% of your core business for $3,000,000. It is an astronomical exit that would make you instantly wealthy, but you would cede all voting power and corporate autonomy. Alternatively, you can decline the offer, retaining your absolute independence but facing their wrath as they vow to fund a relentless competitor to crush you.

choices.label: Sell the Business
choices.description: Cash out now. Secure generational wealth but cede control of your life's work.

consequences.biographyEntry: “The Choice That Defined the Empire: Decided to sell the core enterprise to a global conglomerate, securing astronomical wealth but ceding personal control of their life's work.”

choices.logMessage: 💵 THE EXIT: You cashed out for $3,000,000, surrendering your active multipliers and ceding the brand control.

choices.label: Decline and Fight
choices.description: Refuse the buyout. Maintain your corporate identity and independence, but accept intense market competition.

consequences.biographyEntry: “The Stand: Boldly rejected a multi-million dollar buyout offer, choosing independence over easy wealth and preparing for an all-out corporate war.”

choices.logMessage: 🛡️ THE STAND: You rejected the buyout! Conglomerate agents vow to fund competitors to aggressively squeeze your margins.

title: The Whistleblower's Gambit
description: You uncover undeniable proof of systemic corruption and tax evasion involving the city's key political figures and your closest corporate allies. Exposing the files to the press will trigger a massive political storm, winning public adoration, but it will permanently alienate the corporate elite and spike your physical heat. Alternatively, you can accept their 'hush agreement'—a lucrative compromise that grants you massive political backing but locks in your complicity.

choices.label: Expose the Corruption
choices.description: Leak the files. Win the public's trust and clear your name, but alienate the political elite and face heavy blowback.

consequences.biographyEntry: “The Reinvention: Exposed systemic corruption at the highest levels, choosing truth and public trust over elite compliance.”

choices.logMessage: 📁 THE REINVENTION: You leaked the corruption files! The public hails you as a champion, but federal heat spikes (+40) as elites retaliate.

choices.label: Accept the Compromise
choices.description: Sign the hush agreement. Gain massive political backing and a passive monthly payout, but carry the weight of complicity.

consequences.biographyEntry: “The Compromise: Accepted a lucrative compromise with the political elite, securing immense systemic backing at the cost of personal integrity.”

choices.logMessage: 🤫 THE COMPROMISE: You signed the hush agreement, locking in a +$15,000 monthly payout but carrying heavy moral weight.

title: Brand vs. Solvency
description: Your public profile is slipping while your operating liabilities grow. You can either invest heavily in a brand PR campaign (+1,000 clout, costing $50,000) OR pay down your running obligations immediately to bolster cash reserves.

choices.label: Invest in PR Blitz
choices.description: Spend $50,000 to launch a premier PR campaign, securing high public standing (+1,000 Clout, +200 Aura).

choices.label: Pay Down Liabilities
choices.description: Use $15,000 of cash to retire outstanding obligations, reclaiming $1,500/month in passive cash flow.

title: Project Obsidian
description: An encrypted message arrives from an unknown sender. They want you to design a "backdoor" into a regional banking network. The pay is astronomical, but the risks are absolute.

choices.label: Accept the Contract
choices.description: Code the backdoor. Take the money. Hope nobody finds the digital fingerprints.

choices.label: Report & Secure
choices.description: Alert the authorities and help them patch the vulnerability. It's good for the resume.

title: Leverage Opportunity
description: Your informants have caught a local politician in a compromising position. As "The Shadow", you can leverage this for power or for silence.

choices.label: Political Favor
choices.description: Trade the evidence for a reduction in regulatory scrutiny on your businesses.

choices.label: Cold Cash
choices.description: Simple extortion. $50,000 for the original drive.

title: The Architect Returns
description: The favor has been called in. "The Architect" wants you to use your influence to push through a controversial zoning law that favors their holdings.

choices.label: Push the Law
choices.description: Your reputation takes a hit, but the debt is settled.

choices.label: Refuse the Demand
choices.description: You won't be a corporate puppet. Expect retaliation.

title: Architect's Retribution
description: "The Architect" is liquidating their positions in your companies, attempting a hostile takeover to strip your assets.

choices.label: Fight the Takeover
choices.description: Burn through your reserves to buy back your shares and secure your control.

choices.label: Cede Control
choices.description: Let them have what they want. You'll start over elsewhere, but the sting of defeat is heavy.

consequences.biographyEntry: Lost a massive corporate war against the shadowy Investor known as The Architect.

title: Kane's Intervention
description: Victor Kane reaches out. "I see you're having trouble with the Architect," he says. "I have no love for them. I can provide the leverage to bury them once and for all, but I want your loyalty in the coming trade wars."

choices.label: Align with Kane
choices.description: Accept his help. The Architect will fall, but you'll be in Kane's debt.

consequences.biographyEntry: Formed a strategic alliance with Victor Kane to dismantle The Architect's network.

choices.label: Reject Kane
choices.description: You won't trade one master for another. You'll fight the Architect on your own terms.

consequences.biographyEntry: Defiantly rejected Victor Kane's offer of a predatory alliance.

title: Hostile Negotiations
description: The market is reeling from your recent moves. Victor Kane is aggressively moving against your holdings, attempting to force you into a merger.

choices.label: Counter-Offensive
choices.description: Launch a aggressive media campaign and legal battle to block Kane's moves.

consequences.biographyEntry: Successfully defended the empire against a hostile takeover attempt by Victor Kane.

choices.label: Strategic Merger
choices.description: Merge your operations with Kane's. You lose autonomy, but the combined power is undeniable.

consequences.biographyEntry: Merged the business empire with Victor Kane's conglomerate, becoming a global powerhouse at the cost of independence.

title: The Whispering Hand
description: You've been approached by a representative of "The Whispering Hand", a global syndicate that operates in the gaps between laws. They want to use your logistics network for "special cargo."

choices.label: Partner Up
choices.description: The profits are too high to ignore. Just don't ask what's in the boxes.

choices.label: Tip off the Feds
choices.description: Play it clean. The authorities will appreciate the lead.

title: Syndicate Escalation
description: The Whispering Hand is being squeezed by a federal crackdown. "The logistics you provided for the 'special cargo' were perfect," your contact says. "Now we need something bigger. We need you to wash a massive amount of capital through your ventures immediately. The feds are watching every other door."

choices.label: Wash the Money
choices.description: It's dangerous, but the syndicate pays a 20% commission.

choices.label: Cut Ties
choices.description: It's getting too hot. Shut down the operation and go dark.

consequences.biographyEntry: Severed ties with the Whispering Hand syndicate after the risks became too great.

title: Cole's Pursuit
description: Detective Silas Cole corners you in a parking garage. "I've been watching those 'special shipments' through your warehouses," he says, lighting a cigarette. "The Whispering Hand is a sinking ship. You can go down with them, or you can tell me everything I want to know about their logistics. Your choice."

choices.label: Become Informant
choices.description: Feed Cole information on the syndicate's movements in exchange for immunity.

consequences.biographyEntry: Began working as a confidential informant for Detective Silas Cole against the Whispering Hand.

choices.label: Remain Loyal
choices.description: Tell Cole nothing. You don't talk to the feds.

consequences.biographyEntry: Chose loyalty to the syndicate over cooperation with Detective Cole's investigation.

title: The High-Stakes Heist
description: The Whispering Hand is planning a massive heist of a federal reserve transport. They need you to provide the specialized logistics and "clean" the take.

choices.label: Join the Heist
choices.description: Commit your full resources. This is the big one.

consequences.biographyEntry: Masterminded the logistics for the Whispering Hand's legendary federal reserve heist.

choices.label: Refuse Participation
choices.description: This is too big, even for the syndicate. You're out.

consequences.biographyEntry: Refused to participate in a high-stakes heist, narrowly avoiding a massive federal crackdown.

title: Internal Affairs
description: The syndicate is being torn apart by internal paranoia. They suspect a mole. As a high-ranking member, you are tasked with "handling" the suspicion.

choices.label: Frame a Rival
choices.description: Point the finger at a business rival to clear your own name.

consequences.biographyEntry: Ruthlessly framed a rival to protect their position within the Whispering Hand.

choices.label: Ghost Protocol
choices.description: Use your technical expertise to scrub all records and disappear from the syndicate's tracking.

consequences.biographyEntry: Used elite technical skills to ghost the syndicate and erase all traces of their involvement.

title: Judgment Day
description: The final showdown. The feds are moving in for a total sweep. Do you stand with the syndicate, or do you make your final move for freedom?

choices.label: Take Control
choices.description: Eliminate the current leadership and take over the remains of the syndicate as the new Kingpin.

consequences.biographyEntry: Seized control of the Whispering Hand, becoming the city's undisputed criminal Kingpin.

choices.label: States Witness
choices.description: Turn over the entire syndicate leadership to Detective Cole. Trade your life of crime for a new identity.

consequences.biographyEntry: Dismantled the Whispering Hand as a star witness, choosing a life of redemption over power.

title: Old Neighborhood Debt
description: A figure from your past has surfaced. They claim you owe them for "protection" back in the day. Now that you're rich, they want a payout.

choices.label: Pay for Silence
choices.description: Give them $50,000 to go away forever.

choices.label: Show them the Door
choices.description: You're not that kid anymore. Remind them who you've become.

title: The Academic Rival
description: One of your former professors is publicly critiquing your business model in the media, calling it "unstructured" and "destined for collapse."

choices.label: Public Debate
choices.description: Crush them with real-world results in a televised interview.

choices.label: Ignore the Noise
choices.description: The numbers speak for themselves. You have more important things to do.

title: The Legacy Audit
description: Internal auditors have found "discrepancies" in the trust fund that launched your career. Regulatory scrutiny is imminent.

choices.label: Full Disclosure
choices.description: Pay the fines and open the books. Transparency is the best policy.

choices.label: Mask the Trail
choices.description: Hire the best creative accountants money can buy to bury the discrepancies.

title: The Viral Crisis
description: A video of you has gone viral, but it's being taken out of context. Your brand is at a tipping point.

choices.label: The Tears Video
choices.description: Issue a sincere (or well-acted) apology. Protect the Aura.

choices.label: Lean into the Chaos
choices.description: Any publicity is good publicity. Double down and watch the numbers climb.

title: The Invisible Heist
description: Your connections in the underworld have planned a high-stakes digital heist. As "The Shadow", they want you to provide the encryption keys for the target's vault.

choices.label: Provide the Keys
choices.description: Take a cut of the score. Your involvement remains hidden.

choices.label: Refuse Involvement
choices.description: Too risky, even for you. Some scores aren't worth the exposure.

title: The Strategic Merger
description: A mid-sized competitor is struggling. As an "Institutionalist", you can absorb them to solidify your market share.

choices.label: Hostile Acquisition
choices.description: Strip the assets and fire the management. Pure efficiency.

choices.label: Collaborative Merger
choices.description: Keep the team and build a stronger foundation together.

title: Rivalry Escalation
description: One of your rivals is taking your success personally. They've started a smear campaign to tarnish your reputation.

choices.label: Counter-Smear
choices.description: Fight fire with fire. Leak their own dirty secrets.

choices.label: The Golden Handshake
choices.description: Offer them a "consulting" role to keep their mouth shut.

title: A Fallen Giant
description: A rival you recently crushed is offering to sell you their remaining secrets for a chance to retire in peace.

choices.label: Buy the Intel
choices.description: Their data could give you a massive edge.

choices.label: Let them Rot
choices.description: You don't need anything from a loser.

title: The Leak
description: Ashley has found some dirt on Victor Kane, but her editor is blocking the story. She needs an anonymous source to "verify" the documents.

choices.label: Verify the Docs
choices.description: Confirm the details. It's time Kane took a hit.

choices.label: Protect Yourself
choices.description: Kane is dangerous. You can't be seen helping the press.

title: The Expose
description: Ashley Weaver has been watching your rise. Now she's at your door with a recorder. "Off the record," she says. "How much of this was legal?"

choices.label: Give her the interview
choices.description: The story runs. The spin is yours. Aura skyrockets but heat follows.

choices.label: Buy the story
choices.description: It costs you $500K but the article never runs. Ashley looks at you differently now.

title: Old Debt
description: A courier leaves a handwritten note on your desk. It's from Mook. "I never liked asking for help, and I'm not asking now," it reads. Word on the street is he's in deep with the Southern Cartel. After everything you've been through since the early days, you know he won't survive without a massive bailout.

choices.label: Handle it — no questions
choices.description: You wire $2M and don't ask where it goes. Some debts you just pay.

choices.label: You can't get involved
choices.description: You tell yourself it's business. The nightmares disagree.

title: Community Outreach
description: The community center is thriving, but it needs more funding to expand its programs. Maya suggests a high-profile fundraiser.

choices.label: Viral Campaign
choices.description: Use your influencer connections to make the fundraiser a global event.

consequences.biographyEntry: Leveraged massive digital influence to turn a local community center into a national symbol of hope.

choices.label: Personal Donation
choices.description: Quietly write a check for the full expansion cost.

consequences.biographyEntry: Quietly funded the total expansion of Maya's community foundation.

title: Legacy Conflict
description: Maya visits you in your new office, looking at the city view. "I remember when we just wanted enough for Mama Rosa's groceries," she says quietly. "Now you own the block, and the people on it. Is this really the legacy you want to leave?"

choices.label: Vow Reform
choices.description: Commit to more ethical business practices. It will be harder to grow, but your conscience will be cleaner.

consequences.biographyEntry: Pledged to reform the empire's ethics after a soul-searching confrontation with Maya.

choices.label: Dismiss Concerns
choices.description: Explain that the world is a hard place, and you did what was necessary.

consequences.biographyEntry: Chose the path of the pragmatist, dismissing family concerns in favor of absolute power.

title: The Vane Foundation
description: Your final decision on the future of the Vane family legacy. Will you use your power to lift others, or to secure your own throne?

choices.label: Community Foundation
choices.description: Establish a massive, permanent foundation that will serve the city for generations.

consequences.biographyEntry: Honored their Street Kid roots by creating the city's largest humanitarian foundation.

choices.label: Family Dynasty
choices.description: Focus your wealth on securing the future of the Vane bloodline for centuries to come.

consequences.biographyEntry: Solidified the Vane dynasty, ensuring the family's dominance for generations.

title: The Senator's Wrath
description: Senator Maya Vane has launched a public investigation into your conglomerate's labor practices. "I told you I wouldn't let you destroy this city," she tells the cameras, her eyes cold. She isn't your little sister anymore; she's your most dangerous political enemy.

choices.label: Lobby the Senate
choices.description: Spend $5M to bury the investigation through her colleagues.

consequences.biographyEntry: Ruthlessly suppressed a Senate investigation led by their own sister.

choices.label: Public Concession
choices.description: Accept her terms and reform your labor practices.

consequences.biographyEntry: Was forced into a humiliating public retreat by Senator Maya Vane.

title: Kane's Ultimatum
description: Victor Kane invites you to his penthouse. "You're becoming a nuisance," he says, pouring a drink without looking at you. "I remember when you were just another body in the Mud. Now you're a distraction. Sell me your core business now for 2M, or I will dismantle everything you've built."

choices.label: Take the Deal
choices.description: Cash out while you still can.

choices.label: Declare War
choices.description: You're not selling. Not to him.

title: Political Alliance
description: Sofia Ramirez is running for office. She needs a high-profile endorsement and a campaign contribution.

choices.label: Endorse Sofia
choices.description: Publicly support her and donate 500k.

choices.label: Stay Neutral
choices.description: Politics is a dirty game. Better to stay out of it.

title: The Viral Partnership
description: Leo Thorne wants to do a collab video. "Your brand is elite, but it's a bit... stiff," he says. "Let's show the world you know how to live."

choices.label: Do the Collab
choices.description: Host a massive party and film the highlights.

choices.label: Decline the Offer
choices.description: You're a serious business person, not a clown.

title: Union Demands
description: Sarah Jenkins and the United Workers Union are threatening a strike unless you improve working conditions and pay across your industries.

choices.label: Meet the Demands
choices.description: Increase wages and benefits. It'll hurt your margins, but keep the peace.

choices.label: Break the Strike
choices.description: Hire replacement workers and use legal maneuvers to stop the union.

title: The Foreign Asset
description: President Mikhail Volkov offers a "strategic partnership" between your conglomerate and his state-owned industries. "The world is changing," he says. "Isolation is for the weak."

choices.label: Partner with Volkov
choices.description: Access foreign markets and resources.

choices.label: Keep it National
choices.description: Refuse the offer. You won't be a pawn for a foreign power.

title: The Fixer's Proposal
description: Elena Vance can make your legal problems "disappear" permanently. "I have connections the public doesn't even know exist," she whispers.

choices.label: Retain Elena
choices.description: Pay her a massive retainer for "discretionary services."

choices.label: Handle it Yourself
choices.description: You don't need her brand of "fixing."

title: The Architect's Vision
description: Julian Vane, "The Architect", presents a plan for a new "Elite District" that would require clearing out parts of your old neighborhood. He wants your backing to secure the necessary zoning changes.

choices.label: Support the District
choices.description: The profits from the new development would be astronomical.

choices.label: Oppose Development
choices.description: Protect the neighborhood. Julian won't forget this.

title: The Pop Star's Plea
description: Selena Rosso reaches out. She's launching a global initiative for "Digital Freedom" and wants you to be the primary corporate sponsor. "You have the resources to make this real," she tells you.

choices.label: Sponsor the Initiative
choices.description: Commit $5M to the cause. Your Aura will be legendary.

consequences.biographyEntry: Partnered with pop star Selena Rosso to launch the Global Digital Freedom initiative.

choices.label: Decline Sponsorship
choices.description: It's too expensive and too controversial.

title: National Security Briefing
description: General Silas Whitaker requests a private meeting. "The situation in the East is deteriorating," he says. "We need your manufacturing base to pivot to defense production immediately. It's a matter of national survival."

choices.label: Pivot to Defense
choices.description: Convert your factories. The government contracts are lucrative, but the world gets more dangerous.

choices.label: Maintain Civilian Focus
choices.description: Refuse to become a war profiteer.

title: The Kingmaker's Plan
description: Marcus Stone has a plan to guarantee your election. "We don't need to win hearts," he says, grinning. "We just need to make them hate the other guy more. I need $50M for a 'saturated media campaign'."

choices.label: Hire Stone
choices.description: Launch the smear campaign.

choices.label: Run a Clean Race
choices.description: Stone is too dirty, even for you.

title: Media Monopoly
description: William Thornton is offering to make his networks "extremely favorable" to your administration. "I can make you a saint or a sinner," he laughs. "All I want is the repeal of the new media ownership laws."

choices.label: Repeal the Laws
choices.description: Give Thornton what he wants for total narrative control.

choices.label: Enforce the Laws
choices.description: Thornton's networks will now be your greatest enemy.

title: The Hammer Falls
description: Diana Ross has arrived at your headquarters with a federal warrant. "There are... irregularities... in your offshore accounts," she says, her voice like ice. "I can spend the next year digging, or we can reach a settlement now."

choices.label: Pay the Settlement
choices.description: Pay a massive $100M fine to end the investigation.

choices.label: Fight the Audit
choices.description: Use your political power to slow down the investigation. Extremely risky.

title: The Final Frontier
description: Anya Singh wants to partner with your administration to establish the first permanent lunar colony. "History won't remember your trade deals," she says. "It will remember this."

choices.label: Fund the Colony
choices.description: Commit $500M to the lunar project.

consequences.biographyEntry: Solidified a place in history by funding the first permanent lunar colony with Anya Singh.

choices.label: Focus on Earth
choices.description: We have enough problems down here.

title: Oligarch's Gambit
description: Ivan Morozov has started aggressively shorting your companies while launching cyberattacks on your infrastructure. "I watched you break Victor Kane," he sends in a simple, encrypted text. "But Kane was a pet. The world isn't big enough for two real titans."

choices.label: Launch Counter-Offensive
choices.description: Use your intelligence assets to seize his foreign holdings.

choices.label: Negotiate a Truce
choices.description: Pay him off to leave you alone.

title: Voice of the People
description: Sarah Lane has organized a massive, peaceful protest outside your gates. "You forgot where you came from!" she shouts to the crowd. She is demanding an audience to discuss your impact on the working class.

choices.label: Meet with Lane
choices.description: Listen to her demands. It will show empathy but might look weak to your donors.

choices.label: Disperse the Crowd
choices.description: Order the security teams to clear the area. Order must be maintained.

title: Pops' Legacy Hub
description: The garden is safe, but Pops isn't done. "We protected the roots," he says, leaning on his shovel. "Now let's build the branches. I want to turn this place into a youth training center. Teach them how to hustle the right way."

choices.label: Fund the Hub
choices.description: Donate $250k for a state-of-the-art center.

consequences.biographyEntry: Funded Pops' Youth Legacy Hub, changing the future of the district.

title: The Old Man's Visit
description: Pops arrives at your skyscraper, looking out of place in his gardening overalls. He looks at your view of the city. "I remember when you were just a kid with a bike and a dream, chasing bags in the Mud. You've built a mountain of gold, kid. I just hope you can still see the ground from up here."

choices.label: Remember the Roots
choices.description: Spend the evening talking about the old block.

consequences.biographyEntry: Pops visited the peak of the empire, reminding you that no matter how high you rise, you are still a kid from the blocks.

choices.label: The View is Better Here
choices.description: Explain that the Mud is the past. Power is the future.

consequences.biographyEntry: Pops left the corporate office with a heavy heart, seeing that the kid he knew had been replaced by a titan.

title: The Central Mainframe
description: Twitch is shaking. "I found it. The back-door to the city's financial mainframe."

choices.label: Execute the Siphon
choices.description: Start the diversion.

consequences.biographyEntry: Masterminded a global financial siphon with the hacker known as Twitch.

choices.label: Abort Hack
choices.description: Instruct Twitch to abort the financial mainframe exploit.

title: Slick's Last Score
description: Slick wants to go legitimate.

choices.label: Clean the Operation
choices.description: Invest $500k to legalize the logistics network.

consequences.biographyEntry: Helped the notorious Slick go legitimate.

choices.label: Maintain Current Setup
choices.description: Pass on investing $500k to restructure the legacy logistics network.

title: Rosa's Run
description: Rosa is running for City Council.

choices.label: Fund Her Campaign
choices.description: Donate $100k.

choices.label: Decline Campaign Fund
choices.description: Wish Rosa well in her City Council race without financial backing.

title: The Council Member
description: Rosa won her seat.

choices.label: Push Pro-Labor Policy
choices.description: Work with her.

consequences.biographyEntry: Partnered with Councilwoman Rosa to enact historic labor reforms.

title: The Commissioner
description: Miller is now the Police Commissioner.

choices.label: Clean the Slate
choices.description: Pay the $5M to wipe all heat.

consequences.biographyEntry: Erased their criminal record with the help of the Police Commissioner.

choices.label: Decline Offer
choices.description: Pass on paying $5M to the Commissioner and keep your capital intact.

title: The Global Icon
description: J-Dog is nominated for a global music award.

choices.label: Accept the Honor
choices.description: Share the spotlight.

consequences.biographyEntry: Founded Mud Records and mentored a global music icon.

title: The Insider Tip
description: At the gala, Cassie whispers about a pending merger.

choices.label: Buy the Shares
choices.description: Invest $1M in the shipping merger.

choices.label: Ignore Tip
choices.description: Decide against risking $1M on unverified insider trading gossip.

title: The Final Acquisition
description: Cassie has secured the majority stake.

choices.label: Take Full Control
choices.description: Secure the logistics monopoly.

consequences.biographyEntry: Masterminded the acquisition of the city's shipping lanes.

title: The Sarge's Intel
description: Ray has been monitoring rivals.

choices.label: Set the Ambush
choices.description: Crush Kane's forces.

choices.label: Pass on Ambush
choices.description: Decline Ray's tactical plan and avoid escalating conflict with rival forces.

title: The Private Army
description: Ray wants to scale into a full PMC.

choices.label: Launch the PMC
choices.description: Establish Vane Defense Services.

consequences.biographyEntry: Built a private military empire with Raymond 'Sarge' Strode.

title: The Underground Gallery
description: Lexi is opening a secret gallery.

choices.label: Fund the Gallery
choices.description: Donate $100k to the exhibition.

choices.label: Pass on Sponsorship
choices.description: Wish Lexi success with the gallery without committing corporate funds.

title: The Urban Renaissance
description: Lexi wants to lead a city-wide cultural initiative.

choices.label: Sponsor the Initiative
choices.description: Commit $1M to the cultural program.

consequences.biographyEntry: Spearheaded a city-wide cultural renaissance alongside the artist Lexi Chen.

title: The Legislative Fix
description: Dante has a plan to change the laws themselves.

choices.label: Fund the Lobby
choices.description: Commit $1M to legislative influence.

title: The Hand of Justice
description: Dante is now a Supreme Court Justice.

choices.label: Assume Legal Immunity
choices.description: Finalize the legal shield.

consequences.biographyEntry: Secured absolute legal immunity through Justice Dante.

title: The Elite Opportunity
description: Lila Vance invites you to a private equity round. "Minimal buy-in is $1M. The returns are... exponential."

choices.label: Invest $1M
choices.description: Join the inner circle.

choices.label: Decline Equity Buy-In
choices.description: Pass on Lila Vance's private equity buy-in opportunity.

title: The Vance Boardroom
description: Lila wants you to back her move to oust Julian. "He's old world. We are the new world."

choices.label: Back Lila
choices.description: Commit your voting shares to her coup.

title: The Neighborhood Elder
description: Big G wants out. "I want to run a legitimate security firm. I need a contract."

choices.label: Hire G's Firm
choices.description: Give them the contract.

consequences.biographyEntry: Helped transition Big G's organization into a legitimate security empire.

title: The Panama Papers v2
description: Tessa found a web of offshore accounts belonging to Julian Vane. "I can leak this, but I'll lose my job."

choices.label: Fund the Leak
